instr: Letters: letters appear one at a time; for each one, say whether it is the same as a letter shown a set number of steps earlier.
clue: Letters appear one at a time. For every letter, press Same (right arrow key or button) if it matches the letter the rule below points to, otherwise press Different (left arrow key or button). Answer quickly; the letters keep coming. Press Start when ready.
rule_1: Rule: is this letter the same as the letter just before it?
rule_2: Rule: is this letter the same as the letter two steps back?
rule_3: Rule: is this letter the same as the letter three steps back?
